idea: Track seen items in a set inside dedupe_preserve_order
strategy: data structure: use set/dict/deque/Counter instead of list scans
rationale: `item not in out` scans a growing list: O(n^2). A set makes membership O(1) while the list keeps order.

edits.replace:
out = []
    seen = set()
    for item in items:
        if item not in seen:
            seen.add(item)
            out.append(item)
    return out

reasoning: Membership test moves from list (linear) to set (constant). First-seen order is preserved by still appending to the list. Items must be hashable, which the existing list-based version already relied on for equality.
